answer: Burst cross-exam: at one random second per epoch, every key that answered gets a private follow-up on its own answer and has 30s to reply. A farm cannot queue these; it must reach the summit of parallel load at once. Serving 1,000 keys needs ~50 GPUs at 20 streams each; held an hour for each of 4 daily bursts at $2/hr that is 50 x 2 x 4 = $400/day, while an honest agent pays cents. Each follow-up must mirror a detail only that key's answer holds, so shared replies fail. A key on a slow tundra link may miss 2 of 20 bursts before its pay freezes, so honest outages are not punished.
